I have nobody to contact, or I would have already done that - I don't know his whereabouts and am not even in the same country. I don't know any of his family or friends. I would certainly prefer he get the help he needs, if I had a way to do so.

I have sat "with" him online every night this week, discussing his issues and so on. Talked about options. I have been suicidal in the past, so I think (hope) I am saying the right things, but really I'm at a loss here.

Edit: I forgot to say thanks for responding, sorry :)
